answer_1.quote: Sentence Simplification (SS) consists in modifying the content and structure of a sentence to make it easier to understand, while retaining its main idea ...

answer_2.quote: We analysed the behaviour of two standard metrics in automatic evaluation of SS outputs: BLEU and SARI.

answer_4.quote: For each of the 359 original sentences in the test set, we randomly sampled one reference simplification from ASSET and one from TurkCorpus, and then asked qualified workers to choose which simplification answers best each of the following questions: Fluency, Meaning, Simplicity.
answer_4.guideline: Workers rated each simplified sentence on three criteria: 1) adequacy (meaning preservation), 2) fluency (grammaticality), 3) simplicity (ease of understanding).
